Origin and meaning

The name Virginia has Latin roots and means “maiden (from a Roman family name)”.

About the name Virginia

Named for the US state, which honours Elizabeth I, the 'Virgin Queen'.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Virginia suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
